A distinct intermediate authoring failure used a dict-only completion reader for the leaders list; its failed original is retained before the normal JSON-list reader fix and passing successor. The prior17-test/legacy-pure observations and both rejected candidates remain history, not retroactively approved. The existing PR/reusable finite source-CI registrations remain unchanged and their actual-helper removal/bound mutants still pass. Embedded JS bytes are unchanged and unrun; an exact inert Node proposal is separate and does not grant execution. No Node, GI, SDK, browser, AT, acquisition or native unit ran in this repair.
